newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $7 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $7 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week are expected to total $7 billion in 130 sales, the largest total this year, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $5.7 billion in 60 sales, with a $2.7 billion New Jersey Economic Development Authority taxable deal through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 70 sales totaling $1.3 billion are scheduled. A $300 million Massachusettes deal on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $489 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
